errors.unexpected-end: the JSON ends too early: a value, a quote or a closing bracket is missing
errors.expected-value: expected a value (string, number, object, array, true, false or null) but found “{{found}}”
errors.expected-key: expected a key in double quotes but found “{{found}}”
errors.expected-colon: expected “:” after the key but found “{{found}}”
errors.trailing-comma: trailing comma: remove the “,” before the closing bracket
errors.trailing-content: unexpected “{{found}}” after the end of the JSON
errors.invalid-number: not a valid number: no leading zeros, and “.” and “e” must be followed by digits
errors.invalid-escape: invalid escape in a string: use \", \\, \/, \b, \f, \n, \r, \t or \u followed by 4 hex digits
errors.unescaped-control: line breaks, tabs and other control characters must be escaped inside a string
errors.unterminated-string: this string is never closed with a double quote
